label: علي — نجدي
ref_text: أبغى ثلاثة أرباع النقاط، وتسلم يا سعد، ما قصرت، كذا حل ظريف.
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_v4/wavs/3e0cbb7194a9.wav (id najdi_v4_3e0cbb7194a9: in the najdi_v4 test split, so the shipped najdi_v4_ft checkpoint never trained on it)
notes: Ali (a synthesiser voice described as Saudi Arabic, the most used Saudi male voice in its library), a Najdi male support agent: one of the six voices the omnivoice_najdi model trained on (2,615 of his clips, 5.5 h, in Najdi and MSA). A customer thanking the agent, at his natural pace. Picked from his 25 held-out Najdi clips of 5-9 s: of the ten cloned on eight unseen sentences with the shipped model three came out level, and on 20 more held-out Najdi lines this one gave the most Ali-like clones (similarity 0.876, next 0.852) with the lowest error rate and an UTMOS level with the best. To the accent classifier he is the least Saudi-sounding of the six trained voices, with any of his three best clips and with either language code: P(Gulf) 0.47 on the 20 Najdi lines with ars.

language_check.model: najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250, 20 held-out Najdi lines and 20 held-out MSA lines, each code
